name: Mizuhara Fuyumi
source: Fuyumi Mizuhara is a 79th Generation Tōtsuki Academy Alumnus and a previous 2nd seat of the Elite Ten Council. She is the owner and head chef of the Italian restaurant, Ristorante F.
